content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a NullPointerException (NPE) occurring when attempting to facet a field using `facet.prefix` on an empty field. This happened because the code did not verify whether the `TermsEnum` (te) was null before checking for the `facet.prefix`. As a result, when the `te` was null (which would be the case for an empty field), a method call on it would throw a NPE. The fix introduced a null check for `te` before attempting to use it, preventing the NPE when the field is empty.
